author.role: Specializes in designing, optimizing, and training machine learning models. Conducts data exploration and iterates on models to maximize predictive performance. Collaborates on model deployment, versioning, and performance monitoring.

challenge.name: The Heatwave Blind Spot
challenge.description: A sudden heatwave has shifted demand for seasonal articles, and the current forecast is missing the mark. #model_monica# wants to automate the evaluation harness to test new weather features rapidly, while #requirements_reuben# wants to keep it manual to ensure every test case is rigorously documented before any model change is considered.

output.content: The heatwave has exposed how slow our current workflow is. I need the evaluation harness to push results to the registry automatically the moment a new model version passes its checks. Right now, we wait for a human to notice the new version and manually trigger the hand off. That gap means we lose precious hours while the weather pattern shifts. I want to test new weather features rapidly so we can adapt the forecast before the next promotion week. The faster we can iterate on these features, the better our availability for seasonal articles will be. I am pushing for full automation of this step to remove the bottleneck.
output.reclassify_reason: The author explicitly states a need for rapid iteration and full automation to improve forecast availability, and would be happier with more than the minimum requested (e.g., even faster or more comprehensive automation) to achieve their goal.
